Basic Curry in a Basic Setting
Feb 2019 • Couples
The restaurant is very basic but that's fine with me if the food is wonderful. Unfortunately the food I ordered there was very average, nothing to really enthuse about. The staff however were very welcoming, pleasant and helpful. The veg samosas were tasty enough as a starter as were the masala papads, but I would have preferred the texture of the usual samosas to be honest - diced potatoes as opposed to mashed. The Vindaloo chicken was to a good level of spiciness as was the Malibar chicken but neither were overly tasty, just average. But I think it's worth trying again to sample some other curries and Indian dishes instead.

Decent and reasonable
Jul 2018 • Family
To be honest I underestimated this restaurant for a year but then finally I decided to go for it. I ordered chicken biriyani for take away and it happens to be a bit tastier however what could be improved is the amount of rice (too much) more than chicken pieces (there were hardly 3 breast part pieces ). On my second visit I ordered veg dishes which were also quite tasty, given that I encountered ginger garlic and tomato taste but less in flavours however it serves us right to catch us by a very reasonable price in a demanding location (seriously we cannot ask for more) 

Service: very good
Staff: very polite and hardworking 
Price: highly reasonable if you don’t expect too much but basics

Honestly, if you are in a tight budget looking for Indian food then this would be good place to go to but without much high flavoury expectation

Below average fare
Dec 2017 • Family
I have been living in Ho Chi Minh City for the past three months and this is my second order from Couple Star. We ordered for Chicken Lahsooni tikka, Chicken Reshmi Kabab and mutton Biryani. 

In both the kababs the chicken pieces were cooked but the masalas for which Indian kebabs are famous for had just not gone into the meat. Oil was dripping from the Biryani and had no taste. Ganges, Ashoka and Mr Singh have much better cooking than Couple Star.

I will never ever order from this restaurant and so should you.
